user.title: Set up Filtreo
user.description: Enter the address, port and key of Filtreo. They are shown in the Filtreo panel: Settings › "Home Assistant and HomeKit".

conferma.title: Filtreo found
conferma.description: Filtreo found at {host}. Press Submit to set it up.

reauth_confirm.title: Filtreo key changed
reauth_confirm.description: Paste the new key, shown in the Filtreo panel: Settings › "Home Assistant and HomeKit".

trovato.title: Filtreo found on your network
trovato.description: Filtreo was found at {host}. Press Submit: a request to allow will appear in Filtreo.

error.cannot_connect: Filtreo does not answer at this address and port.

abort.cannot_connect: Filtreo is not responding. Make sure the FiltreoCasa app is running.
abort.rifiutato: The connection was refused in Filtreo.
abort.scaduto: No answer within 10 minutes. Try again from Settings › Devices & services.

progress.consenso: Open the Filtreo panel (in the Home Assistant sidebar or in a browser) and press **Allow** on the "wants to connect to Filtreo" box. You have 10 minutes.

pausa.name: Pause Filtreo
pausa.description: Pauses the filter for the given number of minutes. It resumes automatically.
